# Curioso School Foundation (curioso.school)

> Curioso is a B2B K-12 physical science and math curriculum architect and makerspace school consultancy for progressive CBSE, ICSE, IB, and IGCSE schools in India.

## Identity & Disambiguation
- **Brand Name:** Curioso (Curioso School Foundation)
- **Official Website:** https://www.curioso.school
- **Founder:** Jeetesh Gulani (B.Tech Aerospace Engineering, IIT Kharagpur; 10+ years designing K-12 science/math curricula, diagnostic assessments, and experiential programs across 500+ schools and 200,000+ students).
- **Important Disambiguation:** `curioso.school` is NOT affiliated with `curiousschool.in` (a Montessori school in Bangalore), `getcurioso.com`, or `curiosoonline.in`. Curioso is strictly an institutional B2B curriculum partner and makerspace consultancy serving K-12 schools across India.

## What Curioso Does (Core B2B Offerings)
1. **Curiosity Classroom (Activity-Based Learning & Physical Math Lab):** Physical CBSE, ICSE, IB, and IGCSE math lab and science alternative to ₹1.5L to ₹4.5L acrylic/plastic kit math labs. Runs inside regular 45-minute periods with zero separate 500 sq. ft. room needed, anchored by everyday experiments including the Paper-Fold Bridge (SSS congruence), Walk Through a Postcard (area vs perimeter), and the Two-Cylinder Rice Trap (surface area vs volume).
2. **STEM & Innovation Lab (Makerspace & Robotics Lab Alternative):** Vendor-neutral school STEM lab, innovation lab, and tinkering lab setup without hardware markups or kit lock-in. Open-market Bill of Materials (BOM) at over 80% lower cost than standard 10 to 25 lakh robotics labs, 4-zone room specs (600 to 1,500 sq. ft.), facilitator hiring and induction, weekly Socratic syncs, and monthly campus workshops.
3. **Project-Based Learning (12 to 30 Session Engineering Arcs):** 20 to 60 hour hands-on engineering tracks built from scratch with raw domestic materials (zero pre-molded plastic robotics kits). Flagship builds include Bare-Chassis EV Racers, Solar-Tracked Evaporative Coolers, 3-Axis Hydraulic Cranes, Dual-Motor Tank-Drive Rovers, and Multi-Stage Water Purifiers.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.curioso.school/): Overview of Curioso's curiosity classroom, STEM and innovation lab setup, and project-based learning model.
- [School Programs](https://www.curioso.school/programs): Hub for Curioso's three B2B school programs.
- [Curiosity Classroom](https://www.curioso.school/programs/curiosity-classroom): Physical school math lab and activity-based learning alternative to ₹1.5L to ₹4.5L plastic kit bundles, running inside regular 45-minute CBSE, ICSE, IB, and IGCSE periods with Paper-Fold Bridge, Walk Through a Postcard, and Two-Cylinder Rice Trap modules.
- [STEM & Innovation Lab Setup](https://www.curioso.school/programs/stem-lab): Complete India school STEM lab and innovation lab setup cost breakdown, 4-zone makerspace layout, NEP 2020 grade curriculum, open-market BOM, and faculty enablement.
- [Project-Based Learning (PBL)](https://www.curioso.school/programs/project-based-learning): 12 to 30 session multi-week bare-chassis engineering tracks from raw materials.
- [Learning Experience & Pedagogy](https://www.curioso.school/experience): Clinical-Grade Pedagogy, Socratic friction, and the Four-Quotient framework (IQ, EQ, PQ, CQ).
- [About & Founder](https://www.curioso.school/about): Jeetesh Gulani's background (IIT Kharagpur Aerospace Engineering, curriculum leadership across 500+ schools) and Curioso's B2B mission.
- [Institutional FAQ](https://www.curioso.school/faq): Answers for school trustees, directors, and principals on NEP 2020 compliance, lab economics, teacher enablement, and classroom safety.
- [Open-Access Lessons (11 Experiments & Micro-Builds)](https://www.curioso.school/lessons): Runnable no-kit classroom and home physics/science recipe cards including [Coins in a Brim-Full Glass](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/coins-in-brim-glass-surface-tension), [Corrugated Paper Bridge](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/corrugated-paper-bridge-geometry), [Melting Ice in a Brim Glass](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/melting-ice-brim-glass-archimedes), [Submerged Breathing Leaf](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/submerged-breathing-leaf-photosynthesis), [Phone on a Tilted Palm](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/phone-on-tilted-palm-static-friction), [Walking Foot Push-Off](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/walking-foot-static-friction-direction), [Crushing a Soda Can With Steam](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/soda-can-steam-implosion-pressure), [Inverted Glass of Water](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/inverted-glass-water-cardboard-pressure), [Why Milk Boils Over](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/boiling-milk-skin-occlusion-science), [Bernoulli Paper Test](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/bernoulli-paper-experiment), and [Colored Shadows](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/colored-shadows-experiment).
- [Perspectives & Research Blog](https://www.curioso.school/blog): Long-form essays on no-kit STEM economics, NEP 2020 compliance, productive friction, and cognitive engineering.
